description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application for managing course enrollments. It provides an endpoint for enrolling users into a course by their userId, secured with role-based authorization.

classes.name: EnrollmentController
classes.description: A REST controller managing course enrollment endpoints, allowing authorized users to enroll participants into courses.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Handles POST requests to enroll a user into a specific course, requiring authentication and authorization, and validating the request body.
